questions.prompt: Why are LOLBins effective for an attacker?

options.b: They're signed, trusted Windows binaries — the attacker ships no malware and evades naive allow-lists

questions.prompt: Name a LOLBin abused to download a file.
Best detection tell for a PowerShell-launched LOLBin?

options.b: The powershell.exe -> LOLBin parent-child process-creation event (Sysmon 1 / 4688)
